package: TSSOP20 - 6.5 x 4.4 mm body, 0.65 mm pitch
description: STM32F030F4P6TR - value-line ARM Cortex-M0 32-bit MCU, 16 Kbyte Flash, 4 Kbyte SRAM, 48 MHz max, TSSOP20 [Table 1, Table 2]. Operating voltage 2.4-3.6 V [Table 21]. Source: ST DocID024849 Rev 3 (Jan 2017), STM32F030x4/x6/x8/xC family datasheet, which covers 4 packages (LQFP64/48/32, TSSOP20) and 4 flash-size derivatives (x4/x6/x8/xC) in one shared pinout table (Table 11); this extraction is filtered to the TSSOP20 package / x4 derivative columns only (our exact part). Table 11 alternate-function footnote legend, preserved verbatim in pin notes below: (2) = available on STM32F030x6 and STM32F030x4 only, (3) = available on STM32F030x8 only, (5) = for STM32F030xC only. This part is x4, so functions marked (2) or unmarked apply; functions marked only (3) and/or (5) do not apply to this part but are kept in the notes (with markers) for traceability rather than silently dropped.

pinout.name: BOOT0
pinout.notes: Dedicated BOOT0 pin (I/O structure 'B', Table 10). Boot memory selection, sampled at startup. VIN abs max: 0 to VDDIOx+4.0 V [Table 18]; VIN operating: 0 to 5.5 V [Table 21]. VDDIOx is internally connected to VDD [Table 18 note 3].

pinout.name: PF0-OSC_IN
pinout.notes: I/O, FT (5V tolerant). Reset-default name per Table 11; also referred to as GPIO PF0. Add'l fn: OSC_IN (HSE crystal/external clock input). AF: I2C1_SDA(5) - xC only, does NOT apply to this x4 part [Table 11 footnote 5].

pinout.name: PF1-OSC_OUT
pinout.notes: I/O, FT. Also referred to as GPIO PF1. Add'l fn: OSC_OUT (HSE crystal output). AF: I2C1_SCL(5) - xC only, does NOT apply to this x4 part [Table 11 footnote 5].

pinout.name: NRST
pinout.notes: I/O, RST structure. Active-low device reset input / internal reset output. Internal permanent weak pull-up RPU = 25-55 kOhm (typ 40k) [Table 49]. External ~0.1 uF capacitor NRST-to-GND recommended to protect against parasitic resets [Figure 21]; no external pull-up resistor needed. External reset driver must be able to pull NRST below VIL(NRST) max [Figure 21 note 2].

pinout.name: VDDA
pinout.notes: Analog power supply. Operating range 2.4-3.6 V, must be >= VDD [Table 21]. Abs max VDDA-VSS: -0.3 to 4.0 V [Table 18]. TSSOP20 has NO VSSA pin (see layout_notes) - decoupler return path is VSS/digital ground plane, not a dedicated analog ground.

pinout.name: PA0
pinout.notes: I/O, TTa (3.3V tolerant, ADC-connected). AF: USART1_CTS [Table 11 note 2: x4/x6 - applies to this part]. Add'l fn: ADC_IN0, RTC_TAMP2, WKUP1.

pinout.name: PA1
pinout.notes: I/O, TTa. AF: USART1_RTS [note 2, applies], EVENTOUT. Add'l fn: ADC_IN1.

pinout.name: PA2
pinout.notes: I/O, TTa. AF: USART1_TX [note 2, applies]. Add'l fn: ADC_IN2.

pinout.name: PA3
pinout.notes: I/O, TTa. AF: USART1_RX [note 2, applies]. Add'l fn: ADC_IN3.

pinout.name: PA4
pinout.notes: I/O, TTa. AF: SPI1_NSS, USART1_CK [note 2, applies], TIM14_CH1. Add'l fn: ADC_IN4.

pinout.name: PA5
pinout.notes: I/O, TTa. AF: SPI1_SCK. Add'l fn: ADC_IN5.

pinout.name: PA6
pinout.notes: I/O, TTa. AF: SPI1_MISO, TIM3_CH1, TIM1_BKIN, TIM16_CH1, EVENTOUT. Add'l fn: ADC_IN6.

pinout.name: PA7
pinout.notes: I/O, TTa. AF: SPI1_MOSI, TIM3_CH2, TIM14_CH1, TIM1_CH1N, TIM17_CH1, EVENTOUT. Add'l fn: ADC_IN7.

pinout.name: PB1
pinout.notes: I/O, TTa. AF: TIM3_CH4, TIM14_CH1, TIM1_CH3N. Add'l fn: ADC_IN9.

pinout.name: VSS
pinout.notes: Digital ground. Only VSS pin on TSSOP20 (Table 11 row LQFP64-pin63/LQFP48-pin47/LQFP32-pin32/TSSOP20-pin15); no separate VSSA (see layout_notes).

pinout.name: VDD
pinout.notes: Digital power supply. Only VDD pin on TSSOP20 (Table 11 row LQFP64-pin64/LQFP48-pin48/LQFP32-pin1/TSSOP20-pin16). Operating range 2.4-3.6 V [Table 21]. Abs max VDD-VSS: -0.3 to 4.0 V [Table 18]. Decouple 100 nF ceramic + 4.7 uF bulk [Figure 12].

pinout.name: PA9
pinout.notes: I/O, FT. AF: USART1_TX, TIM1_CH2, I2C1_SCL [Table 11 note 2+5 (x4/x6, or separately xC) - applies to this x4 part via note 2]. Not ADC-capable on TSSOP20 (no additional function listed).

pinout.name: PA10
pinout.notes: I/O, FT. AF: USART1_RX, TIM1_CH3, TIM17_BKIN, I2C1_SDA [note 2+5, applies to this x4 part via note 2]. Not ADC-capable on TSSOP20.

pinout.name: PA13
pinout.notes: I/O, FT. Table 11 pin name is 'PA13 (SWDIO)'. Configured as SWDIO alternate function immediately after reset, with internal pull-up active [Table 11 footnote 7] - debug port is live at reset with no external pull needed. AF: IR_OUT, SWDIO.

pinout.name: PA14
pinout.notes: I/O, FT. Table 11 pin name is 'PA14 (SWCLK)'. Configured as SWCLK alternate function immediately after reset, with internal pull-down active [Table 11 footnote 7]. AF: USART1_TX [note 2, applies], SWCLK.

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to, or below, the VDD pin on the PCB underside
decoupling.notes: Figure 12 (Power supply scheme) shows 2x100nF+1x4.7uF for packages with 2 VDD/VSS pairs (LQFP64/48/32); TSSOP20 has only 1 VDD/VSS pair (pin 16/15) [Table 11], so this scales to 1x100nF
Figure 12; bulk capacitor shared across the VDD/VSS pair

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to, or below, the VDDA pin on the PCB underside
decoupling.notes: Figure 12. TSSOP20 has NO VSSA pin - the return path for this decoupler is the VSS/digital ground plane, not a dedicated analog ground pin (see layout_notes)

Figure 21 'Recommended NRST pin protection': external capacitor protects against parasitic resets. Internal weak pull-up already present (RPU 25-55 kOhm, typ 40k, Table 49) - no external pull-up resistor needed

land_pattern.package: TSSOP20 - 6.5 x 4.4 mm body, 0.65 mm pitch
land_pattern.notes: From Figure 37 'TSSOP20 footprint' (the RECOMMENDED land pattern - used here, NOT Figure 36 the package outline). Pad width 0.40 mm x length 1.35 mm, pitch 0.65 mm, 10 pads/row x 2 rows. Row outer span (tip-to-tip of opposing pads) 7.10 mm; inner edge-to-edge gap between the two rows 4.40 mm; row_spacing_mm 5.75 = center-to-center, derived as (7.10+4.40)/2 (self-consistent: 7.10 - 1.35 pad length = 5.75 also). Overall row length (pin1 to pin10 outer edges) 6.25 mm. Gap between adjacent pad edges within a row 0.25 mm (= 0.65 pitch - 0.40 pad width). Package body dimensions (Table 62 / Figure 36, NOT the land pattern): D (body length) 6.4-6.6mm, E (overall width incl. leads) 6.2-6.6mm, E1 (body width only) 4.3-4.5mm, lead width b 0.19-0.30mm, lead foot length L 0.45-0.75mm, body height A2 0.8-1.05mm, lead coplanarity aaa max 0.1mm.

layout_notes: Each power supply pair (VDD/VSS, VDDA/VSSA etc.) must be decoupled with filtering ceramic capacitors; place as close as possible to, or below, the appropriate pins on the underside of the PCB to ensure good functionality [Sec 6.1.6, Figure 12 caution]

TSSOP20 has NO VSSA pin bonded out - confirmed absent from both Figure 8 (pinout diagram, top view) and Table 11 (pin definitions; the VSSA row shows '-' for the TSSOP20 column). VDDA's decoupling capacitor return path must therefore use the VSS/digital ground plane; this package has no separate analog ground pin

NRST: internal weak pull-up resistor already present (RPU 25-55 kOhm, typ 40 kOhm) [Table 49]; no external pull-up needed. ST recommends an external ~0.1 uF capacitor from NRST to GND to protect against parasitic resets [Figure 21]; any external reset circuitry must still be able to pull NRST below VIL(NRST) max or the reset will not register

PA13/PA14 are already configured as SWDIO/SWCLK alternate functions immediately after reset, with internal pull-up on SWDIO and internal pull-down on SWCLK already active [Table 11 footnote 7] - the SWD port is live at reset with no external pull resistors required
TSSOP20 thermal: package junction-to-ambient resistance Theta-JA = 76 degC/W for the 6.5x6.4mm body [Table 63]; max power dissipation at TA=85C (suffix-6 devices) = 263 mW [Table 21]
